verse.verse_3: And scouring to the raid at dawn.
verse.verse_4: And raise the dust in clouds the while.
verse.verse_5: And penetrating forthwith as one into the midst.
verse.verse_6: Verily, man is ungrateful to his Lord.
verse.verse_7: And to that He bears witness.
verse.verse_8: And verily, he is violent in the love of wealth.
verse.verse_9: Knows he not that when the contents of the graves are poured forth
verse.verse_10: And that which is in the breasts shall be made known
verse.verse_11: Verily, that Day their Lord will be Well-Acquainted with them.
